name: create_zone
description: Creates a zone (a topic box) on the board. Use it when the speaker starts a new topic. kind: flow = step-by-step process; system = architecture of components; list = list of items; compare = two columns compared; mindmap = branching ideas; scale = a quantity that changes along an axis (bar with thresholds: percentage, capacity, time, level); cycle = something that repeats in a loop; timeline = events or phases over time, before/now; tree = a hierarchy or classification that grows from left to right (categories with subcategories, types with their outcomes, breakdowns); data = a data model: entities (tables) with their fields and the relations between them. No coordinates are given: the board places the zone. 'place' only to ask for a neighbor.

left_title.description: Compare only: title of the left column.

right_title.description: Compare only: title of the right column.

min_label.description: Scale only: label of the left end of the bar (default '0%').

max_label.description: Scale only: label of the right end of the bar (default '100%').

center_label.description: Cycle only: text in the center of the cycle, what cycles (e.g. 'Context window').

direction.description: Flow, system and data only: which way the arrows run. horizontal = left to right, elements at the same level stack in a column (a sequence of steps). vertical = top to bottom, elements at the same level sit side by side in a row (layers such as users, frontend, services, data). Omit it when the meaning does not decide: the board picks one from the shape of the graph.

place.description: Optional placement hint relative to another zone.

name: add_step
description: Adds a step (rectangle) to a flow zone. 'after' connects it to the previous step automatically.

label.description: Short text of the step (2 to 6 words).

after.description: Id of the previous element it follows (draws the arrow).

name: add_decision
description: Adds a decision (diamond) to a flow zone. The branches are connected afterwards with connect and a label ('yes', 'no').

name: add_component
description: Adds a component to a system zone. type: actor = person (stick figure); client = browser or phone; service = service box; database = cylinder; queue = queue or pipe; storage = bucket or folder; external = dotted cloud of a third party.

name: add_node
description: Adds an idea to a mindmap zone. Without 'parent' it is the central idea (or hangs from it).

name: add_item
description: Adds an item to a list or compare zone. In compare, 'column' picks the column.

zone.description: Id of a list or compare zone.

name: add_branch
description: Adds a node to a tree zone: a box in the hierarchy. Without 'parent' it is a root (several roots stack up); with 'parent' it hangs from that node, in a column to its right. Siblings stack in the order they are added and the board draws the connectors. Parents before children.

label.description: Short name of the node (1 to 4 words).

parent.description: Id of the parent node (optional; without it, a root).

name: add_mark
description: Adds a mark (threshold) to a scale zone: a notch on the bar with its label and, underneath, a short explanation. 'at' is the position on the bar, from 0 to 100. The board keeps labels from overlapping.

at.description: Position on the bar, from 0 to 100.

label.description: Short label of the mark, e.g. '20%: gets worse'.

tone.description: neutral = ink; warn = amber (careful); danger = red (dangerous limit); ok = green.

name: add_stage
description: Adds a stage to a cycle zone. Stages are placed in a circle in the order they are added (or after 'after'), with clockwise arrows, and the last one returns to the first.

label.description: Short name of the stage (2 to 5 words).

after.description: Id of the stage to insert after (optional; default at the end).

name: add_event
description: Adds an event or phase to a timeline zone: a tick on the time axis with 'when' next to the tick and its label in a box above or below. Without 'at' events are spread evenly in the order they are added; with 'at' (0 to 100) they are placed proportionally.

when.description: Date or short tag next to the tick: 'Before', '2024', 'Month 1' (optional).

at.description: Position on the axis, from 0 to 100 (optional).

name: add_span
description: Adds to a timeline zone a span (brace under the axis) covering a duration, e.g. '2 to 3 months'. 'from' and 'to' are axis positions from 0 to 100, with from < to.

from.description: Start of the span, from 0 to 100.

to.description: End of the span, from 0 to 100 (greater than from).

label.description: Short text of the span, e.g. '2 to 3 months'.

tone.description: neutral = ink; warn = amber (slow or costly); danger = red; ok = green (good).

name: set_level
description: Fills the bar of a scale zone up to 'at' (0 to 100): the current level, e.g. 'filling up'. Calling it again moves the level.

at.description: How far the fill reaches, from 0 to 100.

label.description: Short text over the fill (optional), e.g. 'filling up'.

name: add_entity
description: Adds an entity (a table of a data model) to a data zone: a box with its name on top and one row per field. Mark the primary key with key 'pk' and each foreign key with key 'fk'.

name.description: Name of the entity or table, e.g. 'orders'.

type.description: Short type, e.g. 'uuid', 'text', 'int' (optional; only if said).

key.description: pk = primary key; fk = foreign key to another entity.

fields.description: Its fields in order, primary key first. Only the ones said; may be empty.

name: set_fields
description: Replaces the field list of an entity already drawn: to add, rename, retype or remove a field, send the whole list as it should end up.

type.description: Short type, e.g. 'uuid', 'text', 'int' (optional; only if said).

key.description: pk = primary key; fk = foreign key to another entity.

fields.description: The whole new field list, in order: the fields kept, changed and added. A field left out is removed.

name: relate
description: Draws a relation between two entities of a data model, with crow's-foot ends for its cardinality. Use it instead of connect whenever how many of each side is said or follows from a foreign key.

cardinality.description: Read from 'from' to 'to': one_to_many = one 'from' has many 'to' (a user has many orders: from user, to order); many_to_one the reverse; one_to_one; many_to_many.

label.description: Short verb over the line, e.g. 'places' (optional).

name: connect
description: Draws an arrow between two elements, inside one zone or across zones (e.g. from a step of a flow to a component of an architecture).

style.description: dashed = optional, asynchronous or weak relation.

both_ways.description: Arrow with a head at both ends.

name: emphasize
description: Highlights an element or zone by hand: circle, underline or star. For what the speaker marks as important.

target.description: Id of the element or zone.

name: mark_question
description: Marks an element with a hand-drawn question mark: a doubt, an unresolved point.

target.description: Id of the element or zone.

text.description: The doubt in a few words (optional).

name: add_callout
description: Adds a short handwritten note with a curved arrow pointing at the element.

target.description: Id of the element or zone pointed at.

name: update_label
description: Changes the text of an element, zone, connection or callout (when the speaker corrects themselves).

name: update_text
description: Changes or REMOVES a text inside an element without deleting the element. field: label = zone title, element label or connection label; note = note of a mark, stage, event or tree node; text = text of a handwritten note (callout); when = date of an event. An empty value removes the optional text (note, when, connection label). Use it instead of delete when only removing or changing a text is asked.

id.description: Id of the element, zone, connection or callout.

value.description: New text; empty to remove it.

name: delete
description: Deletes an element, connection, callout or zone. Deleting a zone deletes all its content; deleting an element removes its connections.

name: move_to_zone
description: Moves an element to another zone (of a compatible kind).

name: update_summary
description: Updates the one or two sentence summary of everything said so far.
